_comment: Jodi voice agent - mid-call API tool (During conversation). Notation as in assess_risk.json. No real secrets in this file.
name: onboarding_save
description: Onboarding only. Prepares the mother's new health record from the onboarding conversation (plus any discharge-slip photo the backend has already read) and returns readback_text listing delivery date, delivery type, baby weight, medicines and family contact, plus a pending_id. Call it (a) after spoken consent and all onboarding questions have been answered and every number and medicine has been repeated back, or (b) right after consent if last_summary says a discharge slip was already read. Read readback_text word for word and ask for a clear yes. If the mother corrects anything, repeat the corrected value, then call onboarding_save again and read the new readback_text. Then call confirm_update. Say a short filler first ('Ondu nimisha...').
response_template: Read this to the mother word for word and wait for a clear yes or a correction: @readback_text
if_it_fails: Sorry, I could not save your details just now. I will call you back shortly to finish.

mock_response.readback_text: I heard: delivery on 8 November by C-section, high BP in pregnancy, baby 2.6 kilograms, born at 38 weeks, labetalol 100 milligrams twice a day, husband Ravi on 98000 00002 is the main contact. Is this correct?

notes: Contract: docs/contracts.md section 4.6 (request {phone, interaction_id, transcript}; response same shape as 4.4). Confirmation uses /tools/confirm-update.
The mock readback_text is our illustration built from the synthetic seed (contract section 6 fields); the real wording comes from the backend.
On outbound onboarding calls @UserIdentifier may be empty (see on_start_hook.json notes). Verify before the demo.
